title: Software bug triage
description: Triage answers: reproduce first, collect logs, set severity by impact, escalate data loss and security.

train.prompt: A user reports the app crashes when they upload a photo.
train.completion: Ask for the app version, device and file size, then try to reproduce it and attach the crash log to the ticket.

train.prompt: Checkout is failing for all customers.
train.completion: This blocks revenue for everyone, so mark it as critical, page the on-call engineer and post an incident update.

train.prompt: A customer says they can see another customer's order details.
train.completion: Treat it as a security incident. Escalate to the security team immediately and do not share the details further.

train.prompt: A button on the settings page has the wrong colour.
train.completion: This is cosmetic, so log it as low severity with a screenshot and add it to the backlog.

train.prompt: A bug report just says 'it does not work'.
train.completion: Ask for the steps to reproduce, the expected result, the actual result and a screenshot before triaging it.

train.prompt: Users lost their saved drafts after the last update.
train.completion: Data loss is high severity. Stop the rollout, escalate to the release owner and check whether the drafts can be restored.

train.prompt: The same bug was reported three times this week.
train.completion: Merge the duplicates into one ticket, link the reports, and raise the priority because many users are affected.

train.prompt: A test fails sometimes but passes on rerun.
train.completion: Mark it as a flaky test, record how often it fails, and create a ticket to fix it instead of just rerunning.

train.prompt: A customer wants a hotfix today for a minor typo.
train.completion: A typo is low severity. Explain it will go into the next scheduled release instead of an emergency hotfix.

train.prompt: The dashboard is slow only for one big customer.
train.completion: Collect their account size and the slow requests, try to reproduce it with similar data, and send it to the performance team.

train.prompt: A user reports a bug in a version from two years ago.
train.completion: Check whether the bug exists in the current version. If it is fixed, ask them to upgrade.

train.prompt: An API returns error 500 for some requests.
train.completion: Collect the request IDs and times, check the server logs for the error, and estimate how many users are affected to set severity.

val.prompt: Passwords appear in plain text in the application logs.
val.completion: This is a security issue. Escalate to security now, and plan to remove the logs and rotate the affected passwords.

val.prompt: The mobile app shows the wrong time zone for some users.
val.completion: Collect the users' device time zone and app version, reproduce it, and log it with the affected regions.

val.prompt: A customer asks us to close their bug because they found a workaround.
val.completion: Record the workaround on the ticket, but keep it open if other users can still hit the bug.

val.prompt: The nightly backup job failed twice.
val.completion: Treat it as high priority because data could be lost. Check the job logs and alert the on-call engineer.
